-p: Which ports to check — a wider range (like 1-65535) takes longer and sends much more traffic
--rate: How many checks to send per second — higher is faster, but easier for the target (or its network) to notice or get overwhelmed
--wait: How long to keep listening for replies after all checks are sent — waiting longer catches more results, but takes more time
--banners: Connects to each open port to see what it says back — sends more traffic than a plain port check
--shard: Splits the scan into several parallel pieces — the target sees traffic coming from more than one session at once
